arguments.command:
git add -A && git commit -qF - <<'EOF'
feat: add exclude_tools and model_tools_hidden inputs

exclude_tools disables tools completely; model_tools_hidden keeps them
from the model but callable by other tools, such as pit's tools.*. Both
accept * globs, are resolved after the extensions and their wraps, and
are applied on every run, so an empty input clears an earlier setting.
A name that matches no tool is a warning; no tools left fails the run.
The setup line of the log now shows the tools the model gets.
EOF
npx commitlint --from HEAD~1 --to HEAD && git log --oneline -3
